allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Major update: FAQ page, improved UX, settings reorganization, bug fixes

User Interface:
- Add FAQ page with role-based content for all user roles
- Move Settings from sidebar to dropdown menu \(Header\)
- Add hotel and department info to user dropdown menu
- Improve inventory page mobile layout and text wrapping
- Add Help/FAQ link to both desktop and mobile navigation

Settings Reorganization:
- Move Accounts and MARSHA Codes pages into Settings tabs
- Create dedicated settings components in ui/settings folder
- Reorganize settings into Personal, Admin Panel, Super Admin Panel
- Remove duplicate settings navigation items from sidebar

Backend Improvements:
- Add department info to user response \(formatUserResponse\)
- Fix account deactivation bug \(updateUserStatus was using wrong column\)
- Add audit logging improvements and SSE support
- Add email verification service with OTP
- Improve MARSHA codes management endpoints

Bug Fixes:
- Fix account toggle status not persisting \(is_active vs status column\)
- Fix bcrypt.compare error when password_hash is undefined
- Improve date formatting and timezone handling

Translations:
- Add comprehensive FAQ translations for English and Russian
- Add navigation translations for FAQ/Help

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
